0022600030.text: The Toronto Raptors (4-4, 2-3 on the road, currently on a one-game losing streak) visit the Milwaukee Bucks (1-7, 1-3 at home, on a four-game losing streak) for Toronto's ninth game of the season in the Emirates NBA Cup East Group A. The Raptors are fourth in the Atlantic, 3.5 games back, and fifth in the East, while the Bucks are fifth in the Central, 5 games back, and 15th in the East; the teams have not met yet this season, and Toronto won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 122-94 win in Milwaukee on February 22, 2026. Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture) are both out for Toronto, and Kam Jones (ankle) is out for Milwaukee.
